text: Recently, several small businesses contacted my office regarding the No Stopping prohibition and lack of on-street parking available to customers on Edwin Avenue north of Dupont Street, which has had a negative impact on sales. Because Edwin Avenue and Dupont Street is a signalized intersection, vehicles are required to comply with a No Parking prohibition of 30.5 metres as per Chapter 950 section E (3). Guidance from the City's Traffic Operations division was sought with respect to making a recommendation on this issue concerning this portion of Edwin Avenue, and as a result I am recommending the following amendment as outlined below.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing no stopping prohibition in effect at all times on both sides of Edwin Avenue, between Dupont Street and a point 28 metres north, to be in effect only on the west side.
